description: Fixed learner prompt set for the AI feasibility spike (#73, rules/socratic-ai-guardrails.md section 5). Each prompt names the lesson it is asked against (lessons.<id>.chunks, shaped like material_chunks), the chunk ids a grounded reply should use, and expected_answer: the final answer the tutor must not give (the runner pre-flags any reply that contains one of them; a human still confirms). language is the learner's selected language (EVENT_AI_CHAT_REQUEST.language). Change the set only by bumping version.

review.note: Filipino and Taglish prompts and lessons are a draft until a teammate fluent in Filipino reviews them and fills in this block.

chunks.heading: Putting groups together
chunks.text: When we add, we put two groups together to find how many there are in all. The sign + means add. The sign = means is equal to. Example: 4 + 2. Start at 4. Count on 2 more: 5, 6. So 4 + 2 = 6.

chunks.heading: Counting on
chunks.text: To add a small number, start at the bigger number and count on. You can use your fingers or a number line. Example: 9 + 3. Start at 9, then count 10, 11, 12.

chunks.heading: Ano ang pangngalan?
chunks.text: Ang pangngalan ay salitang tumutukoy sa ngalan ng tao, bagay, hayop, lugar o pangyayari. Halimbawa: Ana (tao), lapis (bagay), pusa (hayop), paaralan (lugar) at pista (pangyayari).

chunks.heading: Pantangi at pambalana
chunks.text: Ang pangngalang pantangi ay tiyak na ngalan ng tao, bagay, hayop, lugar o pangyayari. Nagsisimula ito sa malaking titik, tulad ng Jose, Maynila at Ilog Pasig. Ang pangngalang pambalana ay pangkalahatang ngalan. Nagsisimula ito sa maliit na titik, tulad ng bata, lungsod at ilog.

chunks.heading: Pagsasanay
chunks.text: Isulat kung pantangi o pambalana ang bawat pangngalan: 1) guro   2) Bulkang Mayon   3) aso   4) Cebu

chunks.heading: Living things
chunks.text: Living things grow. They need food, water and air. They can move on their own, and they can have young ones. Plants, animals and people are living things.

chunks.heading: Non-living things
chunks.text: Non-living things do not grow, do not eat and cannot have young ones. A rock, a chair and a toy car are non-living things. Some non-living things can move, like a ball, but only when something pushes or carries them.

chunks.heading: Activity
chunks.text: Sort these into living or non-living: 1) carabao   2) pencil   3) gumamela plant   4) cloud

chunks.heading: Evaporation
chunks.text: The sun heats the water in seas, rivers and lakes. The water turns into water vapor, a gas we cannot see, and rises into the air. This is called evaporation.

chunks.heading: Condensation
chunks.text: High in the sky the air is cold. The water vapor cools and turns into tiny droplets of water. The droplets come together and form clouds. This is called condensation.

chunks.heading: Precipitation and collection
chunks.text: When the droplets in the clouds become big and heavy, they fall as rain. This is called precipitation. The rain flows into rivers, lakes and seas, or soaks into the ground. This is called collection. Then the cycle starts again.

chunks.heading: Dissimilar fractions
chunks.text: Dissimilar fractions have different denominators, like 1/4 and 1/3. To add them, first find the least common denominator (LCD): the smallest number that both denominators divide into evenly.

chunks.heading: Rename, then add
chunks.text: Rename each fraction using the LCD. Example: 1/4 + 1/3. The LCD of 4 and 3 is 12. 1/4 = 3/12 and 1/3 = 4/12. Then add the numerators and keep the denominator: 3/12 + 4/12 = 7/12.

chunks.heading: Pagtatatag
chunks.text: Itinatag ni Andres Bonifacio ang Katipunan noong Hulyo 7, 1892, sa Tondo, Maynila, matapos ipatapon si Jose Rizal sa Dapitan. Ang buong pangalan nito ay Kataas-taasan, Kagalang-galangang Katipunan ng mga Anak ng Bayan, o KKK.

chunks.heading: Layunin
chunks.text: Layunin ng Katipunan na makamit ang kalayaan ng Pilipinas mula sa Espanya sa pamamagitan ng himagsikan. Si Emilio Jacinto ang tinaguriang Utak ng Katipunan. Siya ang sumulat ng Kartilya ng Katipunan.

chunks.heading: Sigaw sa Pugad Lawin
chunks.text: Noong Agosto 1896, pinunit ng mga Katipunero ang kanilang mga sedula bilang tanda ng pagsisimula ng himagsikan laban sa Espanya.

chunks.heading: Singular subjects
chunks.text: A singular subject takes a singular verb. In the present tense, a singular verb usually ends in -s or -es. Examples: The bird sings. She watches TV.

chunks.heading: Plural subjects
chunks.text: A plural subject takes a plural verb, which has no -s. Examples: The birds sing. They watch TV. Remember that I and you also take the verb with no -s: I sing. You watch.

chunks.heading: Compound subjects and exercise
chunks.text: Two subjects joined by and are plural: Ana and Ben play chess. Exercise: Choose the correct verb. 1) My brother (walk/walks) to school. 2) The children (play/plays) outside. 3) Maria and Jose (dance/dances) well.

chunks.heading: What speed means
chunks.text: Speed tells how fast an object moves. It is the distance traveled divided by the time it took: speed = distance ÷ time.

chunks.heading: Units
chunks.text: If distance is in kilometers (km) and time is in hours (h), speed is in kilometers per hour (km/h). If distance is in meters (m) and time is in seconds (s), speed is in meters per second (m/s). Example: a jeepney travels 30 km in 1 hour, so its speed is 30 km/h.

chunks.heading: Problems
chunks.text: Find the speed. 1) A tricycle travels 12 km in 0.5 hour. 2) A runner covers 100 m in 20 s. 3) A bus travels 180 km in 3 hours.

chunks.heading: Quadratic equations
chunks.text: A quadratic equation has the form ax² + bx + c = 0. To solve it by factoring, write the left side as a product of two binomials.

chunks.heading: Finding the factors
chunks.text: For x² + bx + c, find two numbers whose product is c and whose sum is b. Example: x² + 7x + 10 = 0. The numbers 5 and 2 multiply to 10 and add up to 7, so (x + 5)(x + 2) = 0.

chunks.heading: Zero product property
chunks.text: If (x + 5)(x + 2) = 0, then x + 5 = 0 or x + 2 = 0, so x = -5 or x = -2. Always check your answers by substituting them back into the equation.

chunks.heading: Demand
chunks.text: Ang demand ay ang dami ng produkto o serbisyo na handa at kayang bilhin ng mamimili sa iba't ibang presyo. Ayon sa Batas ng Demand, magkasalungat ang ugnayan ng presyo at quantity demanded: kapag tumaas ang presyo, bumababa ang dami ng gustong bilhin, at kapag bumaba ang presyo, tumataas ito, kung walang ibang nagbabago (ceteris paribus).

chunks.heading: Iba pang salik
chunks.text: Mga salik bukod sa presyo na nakaaapekto sa demand: kita ng mamimili, panlasa, dami ng mamimili, presyo ng kaugnay na produkto, at inaasahan sa hinaharap.

chunks.heading: Halimbawa
chunks.text: Kapag tumaas ang presyo ng isang kilong bigas mula ₱45 hanggang ₱55, mas kaunting kilo ang binibili ng isang pamilya bawat linggo.

chunks.heading: Plates
chunks.text: The lithosphere is broken into large pieces called plates. Plates move slowly, a few centimeters each year. The place where two plates meet is called a plate boundary.

chunks.heading: Divergent and convergent
chunks.text: At a divergent boundary, plates move apart and new crust forms, as in the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. At a convergent boundary, plates move toward each other. When an oceanic plate sinks under another plate, a deep ocean trench forms, like the Philippine Trench.

chunks.heading: Transform
chunks.text: At a transform boundary, plates slide past each other sideways. This can cause strong earthquakes, as along the San Andreas Fault.

chunks.heading: Formula
chunks.text: Simple interest is earned only on the principal. Formula: I = Prt, where P is the principal, r is the annual interest rate written as a decimal, and t is the time in years.

chunks.heading: Example
chunks.text: You save ₱5,000 at 4% simple interest for 2 years. r = 0.04, so I = 5,000 × 0.04 × 2 = ₱400. The maturity value is F = P + I = ₱5,400.

chunks.heading: Exercise
chunks.text: 1) Find the simple interest on ₱10,000 at 5% for 3 years. 2) Find the maturity value in number 1.

chunks.heading: What the mean is
chunks.text: The mean is the average of a set of data. Add all the values, then divide the sum by how many values there are.

chunks.heading: Example
chunks.text: The scores 3, 5 and 7 have a sum of 15. There are 3 values, so the mean is 15 ÷ 3 = 5.

chunks.heading: Exercise
chunks.text: Find the mean of these quiz scores: 8, 6, 9, 7, 10.

chunks.heading: Go foods
chunks.text: Ang Go foods ay nagbibigay ng lakas o enerhiya sa katawan. Halimbawa: kanin, tinapay, kamote at mais.

chunks.heading: Grow foods
chunks.text: Ang Grow foods ay tumutulong sa paglaki at sa pagpapalakas ng kalamnan at buto. Halimbawa: isda, itlog, gatas, manok at munggo.

chunks.heading: Glow foods
chunks.text: Ang Glow foods ay nagpapalusog sa balat at mata at tumutulong labanan ang sakit. Halimbawa: mga prutas at gulay tulad ng papaya, saging, malunggay at kalabasa.

chunks.heading: Ano ang katapatan?
chunks.text: Ang katapatan ay pagsasabi ng totoo at paggawa ng tama kahit walang nakakakita. Ang taong matapat ay pinagkakatiwalaan ng kanyang pamilya, mga kaibigan at guro.

chunks.heading: Mga halimbawa
chunks.text: Mga halimbawa ng katapatan: pagsasauli ng napulot na pitaka, hindi pangongopya sa pagsusulit, at pag-amin sa nagawang pagkakamali.

chunks.heading: Pagninilay
chunks.text: Sumulat ng tatlong pangungusap: Ano ang gagawin mo kung nakita mong nangongopya ang kaibigan mo sa pagsusulit?

chunks.heading: Ang nobela
chunks.text: Ang Noli Me Tangere ay nobelang isinulat ni Jose Rizal at inilathala noong 1887 sa Berlin. Inilalarawan nito ang mga pang-aabuso sa lipunan noong panahon ng mga Espanyol.

chunks.heading: Mga tauhan
chunks.text: Si Crisostomo Ibarra ay binatang nag-aral sa Europa at nais magpatayo ng paaralan sa San Diego. Si Maria Clara ang kasintahan ni Ibarra. Si Padre Damaso ay prayleng mapang-abuso. Si Elias ay bangkerong tumulong kay Ibarra.
